en: A sepia-toned, vintage postcard showing a wooded area with a pond (Schwarzes Teich) in the background. Several people, including children and adults in period clothing (late 19th or early 20th century), are gathered by the water and sitting on a bench. The scene is tranquil and natural, depicting leisure time outdoors. There is printed and handwritten text in German on the front.
